parts.label: a
parts.text:
The current in the electrical heater is 2.2  A. The voltage (p.d.) across the heater is 12 V.
Calculate the energy transferred to the heater in 90 s.
energy transferred =  ...................................................... J [3]

mark_scheme.label: 10(a)
mark_scheme.text:
(energy =) 2400 (J)
(energy =) 2.2 × 90 × 12
(energy =) current × time × voltage OR(E) = V × I × t OR (energy =) power × time OR P × t

Calculate the number of turns (Ns) on the secondary coil.

[Total: 8]
